children: Stifel Financial reported record total client assets of $587,622 million and fee-based client assets of $244,377 million as of Aug. 31, 2026.
Total client assets reached $587,622 million, up 10% year‑over‑year and 2% month‑over‑month.
Fee‑based client assets rose to $244,377 million, up 14% year‑over‑year and 2% month‑over‑month.
Private Client Group fee‑based assets grew to $214,193 million, up 15% year‑over‑year and 2% month‑over‑month.
Bank loans, net increased to $25,637 million, up 18% year‑over‑year; treasury deposits climbed 61% year‑over‑year to $12,344 million.
Client money market and insured product balances fell to $23,443 million, down 8% year‑over‑year and 3% month‑over‑month.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Stifel Reports Record Total and Fee-Based Client Assets; August Data Shows Mixed Flows
